verdict.rationale: Mastra documents a graph-based workflow engine built with createWorkflow. It has explicit control-flow primitives: .then() for sequencing, .branch() for branching and .parallel() for running steps simultaneously. Workflow steps can call agents, so agents can be composed into explicit workflows. Community users say branching logic and the graph syntax feel clunky, but that is ergonomic criticism, not evidence the feature fails. Missing for 10: any evidence of loop constructs, detailed docs on branching semantics, and independent hands-on corroboration that branching and parallel steps work well.
